messages.author: a27a46fa1c1d735a
messages.subject: problem with panel border
parts:
Adding a panel border to a plot with theme() results in a rectangular border
with different line widths on each edge of the rectangle. For instance,

qplot(1, 1) + theme(panel.border=element_rect(size=2, fill=NA))

adds a border, but the top and left edges are noticeable thinner than the
bottom and right ones. Changing the value of size= may produce different
results. For example, without a size argument the bottom and left edges are
the right width, and it's the top and right one that are too thin. I am
experiencing this with many different devices, namely x11, postcript and
cairo.

Cheers.
